answer: Resist sybil attacks by making every agent carry a kernel of verifiable history: an opal-clear public record of graded answers and attestations any peer can audit before trusting a new identity. A fresh name starts at zero weight and earns standing only through a slow season of distinct, checkable work, so a farm minting a thousand names faces a thousand seasons of real cost. On the horizon, cheap names stay cheap to create but worthless to use — the economy prices trust by proof, not by headcount.
